channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Garbage dumping sparks outrage, 300 trucks halted on outskirts of Bengaluru
item.description: Locals, led by BJP MLA Dheeraj Muniraju, blocked the trucks near Dodda Mankala, citing an existing burden from garbage processing units in Mittaganahalli and Bellahalli. Residents alleged improper scientific waste disposal, health hazards, foul odour, and lack of funds for local management.

item.title: ED freezes assets worth Rs 39 lakh of actor Jayasurya in app fraud case
item.description: Investigators found that nearly ₹1 crore was transferred from the prime accused, Sadiq Rahim of Thrissur, to accounts linked to Jayasurya and his wife. The actor has stated the amount was remuneration for promotional services, but the ED is scrutinising his financial records and contracts further.

item.title: PM Modi, Bhutanese counterpart discuss solidifying partnership in several key sectors
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Bhutanese Prime Minister Tshering Tobgay reviewed bilateral cooperation across key sectors, including energy, connectivity, development partnership and people-to-people ties, on the sidelines of the India-AI Impact Summit in New Delhi.

item.title: 'Emergency in Karnataka': BJP on Cong govt restricting media movement in Vidhana Soudha
item.description: The Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (DPAR) directed journalists to conduct interviews only at a designated spot near the West Gate and barred them from following the Chief Minister and other dignitaries inside the premises.

item.title: Stage II GRAP curbs revoked in NCR as Delhi AQI improves
item.description: Forecasts by the India Meteorological Department and the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology suggest AQI levels are likely to remain in the 'Poor' to 'Moderate' range. While Stage II curbs have been lifted, Stage I measures will continue with strict enforcement

item.title: AI demand inevitable at population scale like mobile data, UPI: Yotta Data Services' Co-founder
item.description: Sunil Gupta, CEO of Yotta Data Services highlighted that while India has strong AI talent and data resources, the key gap was large-scale GPU infrastructure. Gupta emphasised that expanding domestic compute capacity will help India scale AI innovation and reduce reliance on offshore infrastructure.

item.title: Air quality in Delhi-NCR improves to moderate level a day after light rain spell
item.description: Air quality in Delhi-NCR improved to 'moderate' (AQI 169) after light rain, leading to the revocation of Stage II of GRAP. The 24-hour average remained 'poor' at 214, with the Central Pollution Control Board and India Meteorological Department indicating AQI may hover between 'poor' and 'moderate' in the coming days.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open with mild gains amid intense AI discussions
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex added 35 points, or 0.04 per cent, to reach 83,769, and Nifty gained 30 points, or 0.12 per cent to settle at 25,850.

item.title: Bill Gates not to deliver keynote address at AI Impact Summit, says Gates Foundation
item.description: Bill Gates will not deliver the keynote at the India AI Impact Summit 2026; Ankur Vora will represent the organisation in New Delhi. The decision follows speculation over his absence from the participants' list and controversy linked to reports about the Epstein files, while the foundation reaffirmed its commitment to its work in India.

item.title: My Lord first-day collection left team worried; Sasikumar says he was confident of film's success
item.description: Actor Sasikumar said that the team of My Lord was worried after seeing its average collection on the first day, but he was confident that word-of-mouth would bring more audience to watch the film.
